thread:
mia: Heads-up — I'm trying a layout tweak for org settings. Proposal: make the left 'Access' rail sticky so when you scroll audit logs you still see Invite + Roles context. Mock attached. PTAL.

sam: Makes sense for long logs. Concern: mobile and narrow widths? sticky can eat valuable viewport. :thinking:

mia: Good point — desktop-only for now; collapse to top tabs under 768px.

olivia: Big a11y flag: if the rail is sticky we must preserve logical tab order. Keyboard users shouldn't get trapped. Propose adding a 'Skip to audit' link at top of the rail and ensure focus moves into the main log after tabbing.

kai: Agree. Also for screen readers, announce filter/count changes via aria-live. Quick snippet: `<nav aria-label="Org settings">` and set `aria-live="polite"` on the counts region. Also ensure `button[aria-expanded]` on role accordions.

pat: Invite flow copy tweak: current CTA 'Invite user' mixes human vs service invites. Suggest 'Invite collaborator' (for people) and a separate 'Create service invite' pathway, or at least hint copy: 'Invite people or services'. Also SSO toggle label 'Enforce SSO' reads like punishment — prefer 'Require SSO sign-in' with a short tooltip explaining sign-in & provisioning.

mia: Nice. Can we also dedupe role names between the rail and the modal? e.g., rail shows 'Admin' but modal shows 'Organization Admin' — that confuses reviewers.

sam: On audit search: when filters change the rail shows counts — counts should update live, but current spinner contrast is low. Replace spinner with skeleton lines and set `aria-busy=true` on the results list so assistive tech knows it's loading.

olivia: +1 to skeletons. Also keyboard behaviour: after closing the invite modal, focus should return to the invite button that opened it. Right now it jumps to the top of page. That's a regression.

kai: Small CSS note from prototype: `.sticky-rail { position: sticky; top: 84px; }` worked better with our header height. Cross-browser check needed (FF/Edge).

mia: Can we ship as a small experiment? Devex, can you prototype on the existing org-settings staging page? @design-bot please add an a11y checklist to the PR.

design-bot: Added checklist to the design doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/org-access-sticky-rail. Items: skip link, tab order tests, aria-live for counts, focus-return after modal close, skeleton loaders, mobile collapse. :white_check_mark:

pat: I'll update the invite copy PR with the suggested microcopy. Also want to confirm logging events: `invite_modal_open` and `invite_submit_role` — are those ok?

sam: Logging names look fine. One more product thought: when SSO toggle is on, hide password invite option entirely instead of disabling it — reduces confusion in the form.

mia: Agreed. Let's aim for an A/B rollout: 10% of orgs for two weeks, track invite success rate, keyboard-a11y regressions, and support tickets. I'll draft the rollout and metrics.

olivia: I'll add keyboard + VoiceOver test cases to the QA ticket and flag anything blocking.

sam: :thumbsup: Sounds good.

mia: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the PR link and timeline tomorrow.
